description: MiniMax M3 is the latest M-series model for agentic reasoning, tool use, coding, and long-context work. It accepts text and image input, and its published context window is 1,000,000 tokens. Thinking is adaptive by default and can be turned off.

supported_reasoning_levels.description: Thinking disabled. The model answers directly.
Faster responses with lighter adaptive reasoning.
Adaptive thinking. This is the published default for MiniMax-M3.
Maximum reasoning depth for the hardest problems.
